summary: Require bounded self-diagnosis, allowlisted repair, signed version-pinned updates, isolated canary, rollback and audited retry before fallback away from EKODI-owned executors.
approvalBasis: The EKODI platform owner explicitly requested that EKODI native executors be automatically repaired and updated upon failure and used preferentially while practical tests continue.
mandatoryRules: run bounded safe auto-remediation before external fallback
record each eligible native provider repair outcome and audit id
never bypass privileged OS consent or protected release gates
rollback failed canary and report failure honestly
rollback: Revert this amendment and its routing changes through protected C2 release if runtime regressions appear.
